newsitem.title: FRANCE: MOTOR RACING-LANGTON IN SPECIALIST WARD AFTER CRASH.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-LANGTON IN SPECIALIST WARD AFTER CRASH.

text.p: British racing driver Soames Langton was in a specialist ward for major accidents at a Bordeaux hospital on Sunday after sustaining serious head injuries in a crash.
Langton, 28, crashed his Porsche on Saturday during the penultimate round of the world endurance championship.
Doctors said they could not give any details of Langton's condition without his family's consent.
After the crash, Langton was airlifted unconscious to a hospital near the race venue of Nogaro. He was moved to Bordeaux on Sunday.
